title: Add authored entity existence windows (exists_from / exists_until) across prompts, ticks, and /api/state

sections.what: Support authored ISO-8601 existence windows (exists_from / exists_until) on characters, items, and ways so scrubbing earlier or later in scenario time automatically phases entities in and out.
sections.why: Without authored existence windows, jumping backward in time before a character arrived or an item was created still leaves them visible in room prompts and ticking vitals.
sections.how: Add engine/entity_existence.py with entity_exists_at(entity, current_datetime) supporting ISO-8601 exists_from, exists_until, spawn_datetime, despawn_datetime on Node.properties or Player. Filter items, ways, and players in build_room_context (engine/agent/prompt_builder/room_context.py), guard character vital/decay loops in engine/tick_manager.py, and annotate exists_now in handle_get_state (routes/action_handlers.py).

acceptance.text: engine/entity_existence.py evaluates exists_from / exists_until (and spawn_datetime / despawn_datetime) ISO-8601 bounds against world.datetime_for_tick()
engine/agent/prompt_builder/room_context.py hides items, ways, and people whose existence window excludes the active world_datetime
engine/tick_manager.py skips vital decay and autonomous ticking for characters outside their existence window
routes/action_handlers.py handle_get_state publishes exists_now on players and graph nodes for UI/graph visibility

custom.browser_ui: When scrubbing to an earlier date before a character or item's exists_from (or after exists_until), they are omitted from agent room context, skipped by ticks, and marked exists_now: false in /api/state.
